questions.title: Which Gulf country will announce an indefinite trade embargo against Iran by August 20, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official government announcements, as reported by Al Jazeera or other reliable international news organizations. Qualifying Event : The country's government must publicly announce an indefinite trade embargo against Iran between August 1 and August 20, 2026. Restrictions limited to individual companies or particular commodities do not qualify. Resolution Date : Resolve on the date the embargo is publicly announced, rather than its implementation date. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the country.
